cultural_notes: Jacksonville is a North Florida river city built along the St. Johns, with a strong US Navy presence (NAS Jacksonville, Naval Station Mayport) shaping its communities (source: general regional knowledge; language selection flagged INFERRED)

North Florida sits at the cooler end of the state's growing range: some frost-tender crops are available only in fall in North Florida while being harvested all winter farther south (source: UF/IFAS blogs.ifas.ufl.edu/fycsdept -- Florida winter produce)
Florida's growing season peaks October through May, so citrus and strawberry are winter produce here, not a northern-style off-season (source: fdacs.gov Crops-in-Season; sarasotamagazine.com)
Winn-Dixie was founded in Jacksonville and carries strong local heritage alongside Publix as the dominant statewide grocer (source: Winn-Dixie / Publix regional footprint)
